## Chicken Biryani – Bon Appétit version  

### Ingredients  [Chicken Biryani]  
- 1 lemon [Chicken Biryani]  
- ½ tsp sugar [Chicken Biryani]  
- 1½ cups whole‑milk yogurt, divided [Chicken Biryani]

- 1 red onion [Chicken Biryani]  
- 1 4‑inch piece fresh ginger, peeled, thinly sliced [Chicken Biryani]  
- 2 garlic cloves, smashed, peeled [Chicken Biryani]  
- ¾ tsp ground cinnamon [Chicken Biryani]  
- ½ tsp ground cardamom [Chicken Biryani]  
- 1½ lb skin‑on, bone‑in chicken thighs (4–6 thighs) [Chicken Biryani]  
- 2 dried bay leaves [Chicken Biryani]  
- ¾ cup kosher salt [Chicken Biryani]  
- 2 cups aged basmati rice (such as Daawat) [Chicken Biryani]  
- 1 red onion, thinly sliced [Chicken Biryani]  
- ¾ cup melted ghee or neutral oil [Chicken Biryani]  
- ½ cup mixed coarsely chopped nuts (almonds, pistachios, pine nuts, and/or walnuts) [Chicken Biryani]  
- 1 Tbsp sugar [Chicken Biryani]  
- ¾ cup mixed dried fruit (prunes, apricots, pineapple, and/or cranberries) [Chicken Biryani]  

### Instructions  [Chicken Biryani]  

1. **Raita (optional side).** Finely grate 1 tsp lemon zest into a small bowl, squeeze juice from half the lemon, add ½ tsp sugar, 1 cup yogurt, 1 tsp salt and ¼ tsp pepper; finely chop one‑quarter of the onion and stir into the mixture. Let sit at room temperature ≥ 1 hour or chill overnight. [Chicken Biryani]  

2. **Marinade.** Purée the remaining lemon half, the rest of the onion, ginger, garlic, cinnamon, cardamom, ½ cup yogurt, 2 tsp salt and ¾ tsp pepper in a blender until smooth; transfer to a medium bowl. [Chicken Biryani]  

3. **Marinate chicken.** Remove skin from the thighs (the skin will render later) and toss the meat with the ginger‑garlic‑spice puree, adding the bay leaves. Cover and marinate at room temperature ≥ 2 hours or, preferably, chill overnight. [Chicken Biryani]  

4. **Pre‑heat oven & boil water.** Place a rack in the lower third of the oven; pre‑heat to 350 °F. Bring ¾ cup kosher salt and 3 qt water to a rapid boil in a large pot. [Chicken Biryani]  

5. **Rinse rice.** Place the rice in a medium bowl, cover with cool tap water, agitate gently with a hand, drain. Repeat at least two more times until the water runs clear enough to see your hand through it. [Chicken Biryani]  

6. **Par‑boil rice.** Add the drained rice all at once to the boiling salted water. Stir a few times with a wooden spoon, then stop stirring. When the water returns to a simmer and a few grains appear near the surface, continue cooking until the grains have nearly doubled in size, the water returns to a boil and most rice bubbles to the surface (≈ 3–7 minutes, testing for a firm white core). Drain and rinse with water until cool; set aside. [Chicken Biryani]  

7. **Fry onions.** Cook the sliced onion and ghee in a 4–6‑qt Dutch oven over medium‑high heat, stirring constantly, until the onions are golden and crisp (8–10 minutes). Transfer onions to a plate with a slotted spoon. [Chicken Biryani]  

8. **Toast nuts.** Reduce heat to medium‑low; toast the mixed nuts in the same pot, stirring occasionally, until fragrant and darkened (2–3 minutes). Transfer nuts to another plate; set aside. [Chicken Biryani]  

9. **Caramelize sugar & add chicken.** Increase heat to medium‑high, sprinkle 1 Tbsp sugar over the remaining ghee, and cook, stirring frequently, until the sugar forms deeply caramelized clumps (3–5 minutes). Add the marinated chicken (including any remaining marinade) and bring to a simmer.
